_doc: Batch 01, Castellan in the upper engine room. Warm, easy, folksy; talks to the reactor ('darlin''); jokes when hurt; temper flares and burns out. Never says the off-books work or where Pell lives; the only hint of the second panel is an echo of clue.castellan.0 gated on seen.castellan.hook1.

storylets.speaker: castellan
storylets.summary: Palm on the casing before the watch.

lines.text: Castellan has his palm flat on the reactor casing and his eyes half shut.
Mornin', darlin'. Easy now. Nobody's mad at you.
Castellan has his palm flat on the reactor casing. He takes it away when you come in.
Mornin', Captain. Coffee's strong, if you want it.

source: crew_cards.md: palm on the casing before every watch

storylets.speaker: castellan
storylets.summary: Never throw a part away.

lines.text: A coffee can of mismatched washers sits on the bench, labelled 'Maybe.'
Never throw a part away. You'll want it the day after.
That's not wisdom. That's just how the day after works.

source: crew_cards.md: never throws away a part

storylets.speaker: castellan
storylets.summary: The guitar, and three songs.

lines.text: A beat-up guitar leans against the bulkhead with its strings gone slack.
Haven't played tonight. Didn't want to bother folks.
Truth is I know three songs, and two of 'em are the same song.

source: crew_cards.md: plays a beat-up guitar, badly, when homesick

storylets.speaker: castellan
storylets.summary: The bar bet with Fenwick.

lines.text: Bet's still on with Fenwick. Loser does the other one's dishes for a month.
I'm winning. Fenwick says it's tied. Fenwick's arithmetic is generous.

source: crew_cards.md: long-running bar bet with Fenwick

storylets.speaker: castellan
storylets.summary: He left Quill a sandwich.

lines.text: Left Quill a sandwich. She labelled it and ate it.
That's practically a hug, from Quill. I'm not gonna tell her I said so.

source: crew_cards.md: Castellan has decided Quill is his friend

storylets.speaker: castellan
storylets.summary: The manifold patch.

lines.text: Patch is holdin'. I say that every watch.
One day I'll say it and be right for good.

storylets.speaker: castellan
storylets.summary: Pell is still clockwork.
storylets.needs: integration<10 and not seen.wiring.key_turned and not murdered

lines.text: Ship's still thick as a brick. Pell won't touch a thing it hasn't been asked to.
Polite, I call it. A little lonely, too.

storylets.speaker: castellan
storylets.summary: Pell has a bus of its own now.

lines.text: Pell's on the classifier bus now. Don't let it tell you it's lonely.
It's got a whole bus.

storylets.speaker: castellan
storylets.summary: He keeps a screwdriver in his pocket since the wiring was declined.

lines.text: I keep a screwdriver in my pocket. Four screws on that plate.
I'm not doing anything with it. I just like to know it's there.

source: act1_wiring.md: Your call. Panel's four screws.

storylets.speaker: castellan
storylets.summary: After a rough hunt: the ship has bruises.

lines.text: She took some bruises. She'll tell me where, if I'm patient.
Once she's warmed up, she's a talker.

storylets.speaker: castellan
storylets.summary: A loose ship: hunches.

lines.text: Hunch says she wants her bearings re-seated. My hunches don't miss like the manual does.
That's not a boast about my hunches. That's a complaint about the manual.

storylets.speaker: castellan
storylets.summary: A tight ship: paperwork on the reactor.

lines.text: There's a sign-off sheet on the reactor now. She hates it. I hate it.
Never in my life have she and I agreed on anything so completely.

storylets.speaker: castellan
storylets.summary: He checked the lashings on the sealed store, unasked.

lines.text: I checked the lashings on that sealed store. Twice.
Wasn't asked. Don't know why I did.

source: act1_commission.md: Cold-stores don't weigh that, Captain. I'd know.

storylets.speaker: castellan
storylets.summary: Audit prep: he will scrub everything evenly.

lines.text: Audit at Vesper. I'm gonna scrub this whole room, evenly, so nothing looks scrubbed.
Then I'll miss a spot on purpose. Nobody trusts a spotless engine room.

storylets.speaker: castellan
storylets.summary: Murder route: warm and hurt.

lines.text: Castellan pours a mug of coffee and sets it on the rail where you'd have to reach for it.
You look like you haven't slept, Captain. Neither have I.
That's all I'm gonna say about it.

source: act1_first_morning.md 1.2d: Captain! Glad it's you. I mean... I'm not glad.

storylets.speaker: castellan
storylets.summary: Ames died: no joke in his voice.

lines.text: Castellan is talking to the reactor, quietly, in a voice he doesn't use for jokes.
Come on, darlin'. Keep it steady. We've lost enough this week.

storylets.speaker: castellan
storylets.summary: High trust: he has rehearsed telling you you're all right.

lines.text: You're all right, Captain. I mean that.
I said it to the reactor first, so it's been rehearsed.

storylets.speaker: castellan
storylets.summary: Launch crew background.

lines.text: Launch crew, you said? Daddy used to say pad crews were the only honest folks on a rocket, and he didn't say it about many.
Everyone else is just along for the ride.

storylets.speaker: castellan
storylets.summary: Murder route: she is steady.

lines.text: She's steady. That's all I can promise anybody this week.
Steady's not nothing, Captain.

storylets.speaker: castellan
storylets.summary: Murder route: he starts a joke and doesn't finish it.

lines.text: Castellan opens his mouth to make a joke, looks at you, and closes it.
Thermos is full. Take it if you want it. I won't ask anything.

storylets.speaker: castellan
storylets.summary: He said sensor ghost, and would say it again, quieter.
storylets.needs: seen.shakedown.debrief and knows.decoy_turned and not murdered

lines.text: Sensor ghost, I said. I'd say it again.
I'd say it a bit quieter, is all.

source: act1_shakedown.md: CASTELLAN: Then it's a ghost. Sensor ghost.
